Market today: The mood is cautious, driven by rising Treasury yields hitting a 19-year high. This is a real headwind for growth stocks like your tech and chip names, as higher rates make future earnings less valuable.

Your holdings: SOXL is a major concern, down over 40% and flagged 'SELL.' SPAL, a brand-new, very volatile leveraged ETF, is also down nearly 40%. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the 30-year Treasury yield; continued increases will pressure your portfolio. Also, monitor your leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) closely for further decay and volatility.

Bottom line: Focus on managing risk in your leveraged, underwater positions given the current market headwinds.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or respecting your stop at 200. It's a leveraged ETF, down over 40%, and decays, amplifying losses on margin.
SPAL: This new leveraged ETF is also down nearly 40%. Respect its stop at 21.38 to manage risk on this volatile position.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The market has headwinds from rising yields, and existing leveraged positions need attention.
